findings.issue: preflightFailure (line 749) no longer refuses on remaining iterations, yet normalizeConfig still accepts, validates and persists antiConvergence.divergent.minRemainingIterations, and the 'insufficient_remaining_iterations' reason stays in the failure union. Case: an operator sets antiConvergence.divergent.minRemainingIterations: 3 and a pivot opens with remainingIterations 1. The pivot proceeds with no error or warning, so a setting the code still validates has silently stopped having any effect (review.kiss: an option with no current behavior). Commit c06f0f06831 calls the old refusal unreachable, which is true only at the default of 1. Fix: either stop accepting the key from live config (keep parsing it only in parsePersistedLimits for persisted limits) or warn when a non-default value is supplied. The integration test 'keeps accepting a persisted minRemainingIterations limit without refusing on it' only covers the persisted case.

evidence.out: 99: readonly minRemainingIterations?: number; | 235: readonly minRemainingIterations: number; | 293: minRemainingIterations: 1, | 471-473: normalizeConfig parses antiConvergence.divergent.minRemainingIterations | 1055/1062: persisted limits require and parse it.
